items.title: Congo Ebola outbreak reaches 12,000 cases as some responders evacuate
items.excerpt: As the fast-moving outbreak continues to spread in eastern Congo, fighting between rebels and the army is disrupting efforts to contain the spread of the disease.

items.title: North Korea's Kim vows to build more nuclear weapons after ignoring Trump's overture
items.excerpt: Leader Kim Jong Un reportedly visited facilities that produce nuclear ingredients and called for building more nuclear weapons to cope with threats from the U.S. and South Korea.

items.title: Storms disrupt Thanksgiving travel. And, FCC violated ABC's free speech, judge says
items.excerpt: The East Coast's weather is a major concern this holiday, as it could lead to coastal flooding. And, the judge says the FCC can't punish ABC for satire Trump doesn't like.

items.title: At Albuquerque's Indian Pueblo Kitchen, Native American dishes are the main course
items.excerpt: At an Albuquerque, N.M., museum, the restaurant is just as much of a draw as the exhibitions, with dishes like green chile stew and sweet biscochitos flavored with anise and cinnamon.

items.title: 'Memories of a Good Meal': How food made a difference during WWII
items.excerpt: New Orleans Chef Alon Shaya's new cookbook shares stories of resilience from World War II, centered around food.

items.title: A dish with a story, Thanksgiving with culinary historian Michael Twitty
items.excerpt: NPR's Leila Fadel welcomes culinary historian Michael Twitty into her kitchen for a Thanksgiving cooking session on making Kush, the forerunner to Southern cornbread dressing.

items.title: Court lets Puerto Rico governor fire firm that runs the island's troubled power grid
items.excerpt: LUMA Energy took over the electric grid five years ago. The court's ruling nullifies its contract, and gives the government a year to find a new operator.

items.title: Powerful storms disrupt holiday travel, as Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade is postponed
items.excerpt: Extreme weather that has unleashed strong winds, high tides, heavy rain and floods is expected to impact travel plans of an estimated 81.5 million people as they travel across the United States.

items.title: FCC says SpaceX can deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space. Scientists are skeptical
items.excerpt: The Trump administration gave Elon Musk's SpaceX the green light to deploy 1 million satellites that it said would create data centers in space, a move that has raised skepticism among scientists.

items.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
items.excerpt: Taylor revealed his battle with Stage 4 metastatic prostate cancer in 2022. He was the guitarist of the 1980s English band Duran Duran, whose pop hits included "Hungry Like the Wolf" and "Rio".
